chapter: Breakup of Hines band to Lefty Bates
title: Why Hines broke up the band
summary: Rumored Goodman offer, cocktail lounge idea.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Tell me something about when Earl broke up the band, had this falling out with Fox, and I've also heard that he had an offer to go with Benny Goodman, and, you know --
I don't know. I don't know what happened with that, why he changed his mind.
Well, was he going to go with Benny?
He was also talking about having his cocktail lounge.
This cocktail lounge, and, I don't know, that didn't seem to set well with him. He wouldn't have liked that no how, I don't think. Sitting in your own cocktail lounge playing piano.
Was he going to do a solo, or --
Yeah, he was going to sing -- oh, maybe a trio.
Well, whose idea was that? Was it his, or his old lady's, or --
Well, it was mostly his. With a few suggestions.
And that's all you care to say?
